Input images: Image 1 is STYLE reference only, a gallery of cute round anime meme stickers. Image 2 is CHARACTER IDENTITY reference only, the silver-haired blue-eyed headphone-wearing anime woman.
Primary request: Reimagine the woman from image 2 in the bold, playful, very short round chibi sticker style of image 1. One character only. Big soft round head, tiny stubby body and little mitten hands, about 1.8 heads tall. Silver-white hair in a few broad rounded locks with pale cyan tips, bright simple blue eyes, small ahoge, round cheeks with blush. Oversized simple white/navy headphones around her neck. White jacket over navy outfit, cyan trim, little navy boots.
Pose: standing full-body, seriously studying an open navy book while holding an oversized blue pencil; comically determined expression with tiny furrowed brows and puffed cheeks, one little cartoon thought puff. Clear compact silhouette, entire hair and boots in frame.
Style: strongly match the sticker drawings in image 1: thick dark navy hand-drawn contours, broad flat pastel fills, only one simple cel shadow tone, bold expressive face, minimal details, cute internet emote. Simple hair shapes and simple eyes with only one or two highlights. Do NOT make a detailed polished anime illustration, 3D render, glossy collectible, or realistic portrait. No intricate costume detailing or metallic gradients. No maid costume, no whale character.
Composition: square canvas, isolated centered sticker with about 6 percent empty padding, character occupies most of the image, legible at 120px. Subtle white sticker edge only.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha outside the sticker, no solid background and no checkerboard drawn into pixels.
No text, letters, words, logos, watermark, panel or grid.
